rows.commentary: 5.4: Noorullah Ayobi spears it into the pads, and Aaryavir Sehwag works it away into the leg side to scamper back for a comfortable couple.
5.5: Noorullah Ayobi drops it short and wide outside off, drawing a horizontal slash from Sehwag that takes a thick outside edge and races down to third man.
5.6: Noorullah Ayobi serves a good length just outside off, and Lakshya Rajesh Raichandani gets directly behind the line to dead-bat it toward point.
6.1: Naseem Khan offers width outside off on a short length, and Aaryavir Sehwag stands tall to cut it straight to deep point for a single.
6.2: Naseem Khan fires it full onto the pads, and Lakshya times his flick sweetly but hits the square leg fielder straight on.
6.3: Naseem Khan watches as Lakshya drops the ball softly in front of covers, sparking an electric dash that safely beats the throw.
6.4: Naseem Khan strays onto the pads with a full delivery, and Aaryavir Sehwag ruthlessly whips it past square leg to find the boundary rope.
6.5: Naseem Khan goes short and wide, prompting a fierce cut from Sehwag that is brilliantly intercepted by a diving point fielder.
6.6: Naseem Khan extracts a hint of swing outside off, inviting Lakshya to push firmly toward the cover region.
7.1: Noorullah Ayobi digs it back of a length outside off, where Sehwag plays off the back foot to steer it toward point.
7.2: Noorullah Ayobi angles one well wide of the off stump, allowing Sehwag to watch it sail cleanly through to the wicketkeeper.
7.3: Noorullah Ayobi pitches on a good length outside off, and Sehwag pushes it softly onto the off side.
7.4: Noorullah Ayobi lands it on a probing channel outside off, tempting Aaryavir Sehwag into a defensive push that only flirts with the outside edge.
7.5: Width offered by Noorullah Ayobi allows Aaryavir Sehwag to rock back and punch firmly straight into the hands at cover-point.
7.6: Another dot concludes the set as Aaryavir Sehwag works the back foot toward point to seal the over.
8.1: Naseem Khan strays onto the pads, allowing Lakshya Raichandani to flick it away neatly into the leg side for a single.
8.2: Naseem Khan digs it in short of a length outside off, prompting Aaryavir Sehwag to retreat and block safely toward covers.
8.3: Seizing upon width from Naseem Khan, Aaryavir Sehwag flashes a cut sharply toward the fielder positioned just to the right of point.
8.4: Naseem Khan targets the channel outside off with a short delivery that Aaryavir Sehwag awkwardly jabs down toward mid-on.
8.5: Dot ball from Naseem Khan to Aaryavir Sehwag.
21.6: Ayaan Misbah drops it short and angles it in, allowing VK Vineeth to retreat and pull it firmly down to deep square for a single.
22.1: Bilal Khan enters the attack and watches VK Vineeth smoothly glide the ball down to long-on to rotate the strike.
22.2: Bilal Khan darts one in with sharp turn, catching Aaryavir Sehwag tucking it down toward short fine for a dot.
22.3: Bilal Khan keeps it tight as Aaryavir Sehwag hangs back in his crease to solidly defend the delivery right back to the bowler.
22.4: Bilal Khan digs it in short and sneaks it low, forcing Aaryavir Sehwag into a mistimed pull that trickles away to deep mid for a single.
22.5: Bilal Khan tosses this one up outside off stump, inviting VK Vineeth to whip it down toward long-on for an easy single.
22.6: Bilal Khan gets the ball to spin inward, dragging down a short delivery that Aaryavir Sehwag mistimes into a pull toward deep mid for one.
23.1: Ayaan Misbah angles one in sharply, and Aaryavir Sehwag tucks it down to long-on for a single that brings up the hundred for the Indians.
23.2: Ayaan Misbah fires it in full at the stumps, jamming VK Vineeth into a hurried stroke punched down into the off-side.
23.3: Ayaan Misbah attacks the sticks with an angled delivery, safely tucked down to deep mid by VK Vineeth for a brisk single.
23.4: Ayaan Misbah targets the back of a length and angles it in, met by Aaryavir Sehwag with a soft pat down to mid-off.
23.5: Ayaan Misbah lands it on a length with an inward angle, allowing Aaryavir Sehwag to nudge it down to long-on for a single.
23.6: Ayaan Misbah fires a length delivery outside off, beating VK Vineeth as the ball nips away sharply past the outside edge.
24.1: Bilal Khan tosses it up outside off, allowing Aaryavir Sehwag to stroke it down to long-off for a comfortable single.
24.2: Bilal Khan drops in a low dipping full toss, whipped away by VK Vineeth toward long-on to rotate the strike.
24.3: Bilal Khan gets the ball turning in sharply, forcing Aaryavir Sehwag to nudge it softly toward mid-wicket.
24.4: Bilal Khan darts one in with further turn, and Aaryavir Sehwag whips it straight to the mid-wicket fielder.
24.5: Bilal Khan delivers a tighter line as Aaryavir Sehwag tucks it down toward deep mid-wicket for a sharp single.
24.6: Bilal Khan pushes a very full ball right onto the sticks, driven firmly straight back to the bowler by VK Vineeth.
25.1: No run for Aaryavir Sehwag off Ayaan Misbah.
37.1: Noorullah Ayobi drops it short outside off, and Aaryavir Sehwag languidly camps back to crack it wide of deep cover for four.
37.2: Noorullah Ayobi goes short again outside off, prompting Aaryavir Sehwag to punch a single down toward deep cover.
37.3: Noorullah Ayobi targets the pads with a length ball angled in, catching VK Vineeth as he misjudges the tuck down leg.
37.4: Noorullah Ayobi slides another down leg, leaving VK Vineeth to miss the tuck before the umpire rules it off the pads.
37.5: VK Vineeth nudges a single down to short fine as the fielder throws himself into a desperate dive.

37.6: Noorullah Ayobi drags his length up slightly, enticing Aaryavir Sehwag into a drive on the up that drills straight to mid-off, just as the team's second hundred arrives off a blistering 84 balls.
38.1: VK Vineeth dabs Zainullah Rehmani down to short third to rotate the strike for a single.
38.2: Zainullah Rehmani tosses one up, inviting Aaryavir Sehwag to dance down and smash it hard, only to see the chance spilled.
38.3: Zainullah Rehmani smartly shortens his length upon seeing Aaryavir Sehwag charge, forcing the batter to stab it into the off-side for a single.
38.4: Zainullah Rehmani offers width outside off, allowing VK Vineeth to slap it away to deep cover for a single.
38.5: Zainullah Rehmani attacks the sticks, getting Aaryavir Sehwag to tuck it securely toward mid-wicket.
38.6: Zainullah Rehmani bowls it fuller, and Aaryavir Sehwag hangs back to punch a comfortable single down to long-off.
39.1: Noorullah Ayobi pitches it on a length outside off, drawing an edge from Aaryavir Sehwag that slips through the keeper's gloves and leaves him writhing on the turf in agony.
39.2: Noorullah Ayobi delivers on a length, and Aaryavir Sehwag steers it down to deep backward point to rotate the strike with a single.
39.3: Noorullah Ayobi angles a length ball into VK Vineeth, who solidly defends it straight back to the bowler.
39.4: Noorullah Ayobi rolls out a slower delivery wide of off stump, allowing VK Vineeth to stab it into the off-side for a single.
39.5: Noorullah Ayobi targets the stumps after a quiet period, and Aaryavir Sehwag nudges it down toward mid-wicket without score.
39.6: A single to Aaryavir Sehwag off Noorullah Ayobi.
47.1: Ayaan Misbah fires it fuller and angled in, allowing Anvay Dravid to drop underneath the slower delivery and muscle it high over long-on for a massive maximum.
47.2: Ayaan Misbah delivers another fuller ball angled in, which Anvay Dravid neatly clips away toward long-on to comfortably rotate the strike.
47.3: Ayaan Misbah offers width with a short delivery, prompting Yashbardhan Chauhan to slash it down to deep cover where it lands just short of the fielder for a single.
47.4: Ayaan Misbah digs a short ball in outside the off stump, and Anvay Dravid watches it sail safely through to the wicketkeeper while offering no shot.
47.5: Ayaan Misbah goes short again outside off, and Anvay Dravid swivels to pull it down toward deep mid-wicket for a single.
47.6: Ayaan Misbah serves up a short and wide offering, slashed away toward point before the deep cover fielder sprints across to brilliantly cut it off, restricting them to two runs.
48.1: Naseem Khan introduces a slower ball dug into the deck, catching an early-swinging Anvay Dravid completely off guard as he walks across and misses his intended scoop entirely.

48.2: Naseem Khan strikes with a fuller delivery outside off as Anvay Dravid attempts to force the pace, slicing it straight to Hadayatullah Khan who takes a clean catch inside the deep cover ropes to claim a crucial wicket.
48.3: Naseem Khan digs in a slower bumper that evades Manal Chauhan's attempted pull shot, squeezing past the frantic wicketkeeper to yield a valuable bye.
48.4: Naseem Khan angles a length delivery into the batter, allowing Yashbardhan Chauhan to swat it firmly down to deep mid-wicket for a single.
48.5: Naseem Khan slips past the front line with a no-ball as Manal Chauhan pulls the short delivery inward for a single.
48.5: Naseem Khan digs it short outside off and Yashbardhan Chauhan slashes it cleanly over cover to take a single.
48.6: Naseem Khan delivers a slower length ball that bypasses Manal Chauhan's wild slog to shatter the stumps, claiming his fourth wicket amid a ferocious roar as India falters at the death.
49.1: Ayaan Misbah entices Yashbardhan Chauhan into a mis-hit, safely snaffled by Mohamed Nafees to halt the batter's brisk seventeen-run cameo.
4.5: Ishan Sood tests Ayaan Misbah, who rocks back to dead-bat the delivery cleanly toward the cover fielder.
4.6: Ishan Sood drops it short outside off, allowing Ayaan Misbah to rise tall and punch it firmly straight to mid-off.
5.1: Mohit Ulva offers width with a short ball, prompting Zainullah Rehmani to slash hard and slice a thick outside edge bouncing down to third man.
5.2: Mohit Ulva watches Ayaan Misbah clip the ball neatly off his pads into the deep square leg pocket for a comfortable single.
5.3: Mohit Ulva completely misjudges his slower ball, straying miles outside the tramline to gift the batting side a wide.
5.3: Mohit Ulva targets middle stump on a good length, and Zainullah Rehmani firmly blocks it straight back to the bowler.
5.4: Mohit Ulva serves up width outside off, but Zainullah Rehmani miscues his cut straight to the point fielder.
5.5: Mohit Ulva lands it on a good length outside off, and Zainullah Rehmani cushions it softly toward cover with gentle hands.
5.6: Mohit Ulva induces an uppish drive from Zainullah Rehmani off an inside edge, drawing a sensational diving effort from the mid-wicket fielder who gets a hand to it but cannot hold on.
6.1: Ishan Sood delivers a length ball that Ayaan Misbah simply nudges across toward the off-side.
6.2: Ishan Sood pitches back of a length outside off, and Ayaan Misbah stands tall to thrash a gorgeous back-foot punch through covers past a despairing dive from mid-off for four.
6.3: Ishan Sood beats the timing of Ayaan Misbah, who can only mistime his push into the on-side.
6.4: Ishan Sood pitches it on a good length to Ayaan Misbah, who pushes hard with the bat, ballooning a return catch straight back that Ishan puts down to his left in disbelief.
6.5: Ishan Sood delivers to Ayaan Misbah, who forces a fierce drive back that lobs just over the bowler's outstretched right hand in his followthrough and races away toward the boundary for two runs.
6.6: Ishan Sood tosses it up to Ayaan Misbah, who strides forward to dead-bat the delivery solidly into the off-side.
7.1: Mohit Ulva angles a length ball outside off to Zainullah Rehmani, who flashes a thick inside edge past the stumps and down to fine leg for a single.
7.2: Mohit Ulva fires it in to Ayaan Misbah, who tucks the ball away from his pads toward square leg to rotate the strike.
7.3: Mohit Ulva drops it short into the pads of Zainullah Rehmani, who shapes up brilliantly and pulls it with exquisite timing all the way to the deep square leg boundary for four.
7.4: Mohit Ulva bowls a short and wide delivery outside off to Zainullah Rehmani, who flashes hard at it and misses completely.
7.5: Mohit Ulva cleverly disguises an off-cutter on off-stump, allowing Zainullah Rehmani to pick it early and block it safely into the off-side.
20.3: Manal Chauhan drops it in, and Yayin Rai steers it gently toward the off-side.
20.4: Manal Chauhan offers width outside off, allowing Yayin Rai to slice the cut shot out to sweeper cover for a single.
20.5: Manal Chauhan attacks the stumps, forcing Ahmed Khudadad to dead-bat the ball straight back to the bowler.
20.6: Manal Chauhan slides one in flat on the wicket, met solidly by Ahmed Khudadad right back at the bowler.
21.1: Yashbardhan Chauhan tosses up an off-break on middle, clipped smoothly by Yayin Rai toward mid-wicket.
21.2: Yashbardhan Chauhan drifts it in, and Yayin Rai shuffles across to glance it behind square for a brisk single.
21.3: Yashbardhan Chauhan probes on a length, smothered soundly into the pitch by Ahmed Khudadad.
21.4: Yashbardhan Chauhan grips one into the right-hander, permitting Ahmed Khudadad to nudge it past mid-wicket for a single.
21.5: Yashbardhan Chauhan darts a quicker delivery into off-stump, met by a firm defensive push from Yayin Rai toward the covers.
21.6: Yashbardhan Chauhan flights it up, and Yayin Rai dances down the track to launch a towering maximum soaring over the deep mid-wicket boundary.
22.1: Aryan Savsani tempts Ahmed Khudadad into a hard prod, resulting in a thick outside edge flashing away to the left of point.
22.2: Aryan Savsani loops it up on middle, and Ahmed Khudadad dead-bats it right back to the bowler's hands.
22.3: Aryan Savsani offers a full delivery wide of off stump, punched crisply into the turf before the bowler throws himself across to parry it with a sharp interception.
22.4: Aryan Savsani floats another delivery up, and Ahmed Khudadad answers by stroking it smoothly down the ground toward long-off to pick up a single.
22.5: Aryan Savsani fires this one in at Yayin Rai, who simply presents the full face of the bat and returns it safely along the ground to the bowler.
22.6: Aryan Savsani keeps it tight as Yayin Rai strides forward on the front foot to dead-bat the ball straight back to the waiting hands of the bowler.
23.1: Yashbardhan Chauhan pitches it up to Ahmed Khudadad, who sends a cleanly struck drive directly towards long-off to rotate the strike.
23.2: Yashbardhan Chauhan angles one into the right-hander, prompting Yayin Rai to tuck it neatly away towards the mid-wicket fielder.
35.2: Arjun Rajput comes round the wicket with a flat delivery, and Uddish Suri strides out to edge it down to short third.
35.3: Arjun Rajput tosses one up on the sticks, drawing a soft leading edge from Uddish Suri straight back to the bowler.
35.4: Arjun Rajput pushes it through, and Uddish Suri tucks the ball down to deep mid for a single.
35.5: Arjun Rajput delivers a flatter one that Ahmed Khudadad sits down on and muscles away to deep mid for a single.
35.6: Arjun Rajput watches Uddish Suri pat the ball into the off-side, instantly rejecting a risky single.
36.1: Manal Chauhan fires in a flatter trajectory, angled in, which Ahmed Khudadad stabs firmly back to the bowler.
36.2: Manal Chauhan pitches fuller onto the pads, allowing Ahmed Khudadad to clip it wide of mid-wicket for a single.
36.3: Manal Chauhan bowls a testing line as Uddish Suri nudges the ball down into the on-side to find mid-wicket.
36.4: Manal Chauhan drops it short outside off, catching Uddish Suri's edge past a diving slip fielder for a brace.
36.5: Manal Chauhan slides through a flatter delivery, and Uddish Suri quickly stabs it down into the off-side.
36.6: Manal Chauhan floats up a tempting delivery, which Uddish Suri pats safely down towards cover.
37.1: Kavya Patel targets a length outside off, neatly patted down to the eager fielder stationed at point.
37.2: Kavya Patel tosses it up to Ahmed Khudadad who gently guides it into the off-side for a single, ignoring the scrambling overthrow.
37.3: Kavya Patel lands this one on a length outside the off stump, tempting Uddish Suri into a punch that encounters only thin air.
37.4: Kavya Patel darts this in at an angle, allowing Uddish Suri to tuck it neatly behind square for a brisk single.
37.5: Kavya Patel angles another delivery in, and Ahmed Khudadad simply pats it into the off-side to rotate the strike.
37.6: Kavya Patel delivers with soft hands as Uddish Suri dead-bats it down into the off-side for a sharp single.
38.1: Manal Chauhan slides one through to cover, where Uddish Suri scurries across for a single.
38.2: Manal Chauhan offers width, and Ahmed Khudadad accepts, driving it securely out toward long-off for one.
47.6: Ishan Sood fires it full and angles it inward, allowing Naseem Khan to jam it down toward long-on for a single.
48.1: Kavya Patel offers a fuller delivery outside off, and Naseem Khan swings in vain trying to steer it away.
48.2: Kavya Patel executes another pinpoint yorker wide outside off, completely eluding Naseem Khan's attempted jam.
48.3: Kavya Patel disguises a slower delivery well wide of off stump, watching it sail past as Naseem Khan wisely lets it go for a wide.
48.3: Kavya Patel attacks with a very full ball outside off, leaving Naseem Khan grasping at thin air.
48.4: Kavya Patel drops a low full toss outside off, which Naseem Khan stabs into the off-side to pinch a single.
48.5: Kavya Patel serves a fuller length outside off, drilled powerfully down to deep cover by Muhammad Saad for a brisk single.
48.6: Kavya Patel delivers a low full toss outside off that Naseem Khan tries to slap, only to feather an edge safely to the keeper.
49.1: Ishan Sood delivers to Muhammad Saad, an on-side stroke is reined in by the third umpire who flashes the red light for a no-ball.
49.1: Ishan Sood comes back with a very full, angling delivery that Muhammad Saad jams down to long-on for a single.
49.2: Ishan Sood pushes it very full again, and Naseem Khan tickles it off the cue-end down to long-on to rotate the strike.
49.3: Ishan Sood tosses up a low full toss that Muhammad Saad heaves across the line, holing out to Arjun Rajput who dives sharply to his right at deep mid-wicket.
49.4: Ishan Sood lands a fuller delivery angling across, inviting Hadayatullah Khan into a drive that sails into empty air.
49.5: Coming round the wicket, Ishan Sood targets the channel outside off as Hadayatullah Khan swings wildly and makes no contact.
49.6: Ishan Sood spears a full delivery straight into the stumps as Hadayatullah Khan backs away, sealing a 70-run victory for India and completing a four-wicket haul for the fast bowler.
Ishan Sood strikes twice in the over, capping off a stellar bowling effort as UAEU19 finishes all out on 239!

summary.text: India U19 scored 309-7 in their innings, powered by Aaryavir Sehwag who was the top scorer with 160 off 168 balls, while Naseem Khan took 4 for 48 as the best bowling against them. In response, UAEU19 reached 239-10 with Ahmed Khudadad as their top scorer with 74 off 74 balls, as Ishan Sood claimed 4 for 37 for the best bowling against them to secure a 70 run victory for India U19.
